digest.component_or_area: plan review Pass-1 finder context-limit escalation
propositions: A Bedrock-qualified primary model escalates to a bare Anthropic id by discarding the provider qualifier when the model-class table is unconfigured.
The rung target decision is derived only from the constant ladder, never from the run's actual configured model, causing provider mismatches in provider-isolated containers.
The entry rung is resolved through the model-class vocabulary but escalation rungs bypass it, creating inconsistency in provider handling.
When cfg.model is bedrock-qualified and the class table is unconfigured, the one-criterion retry substitutes a bare Anthropic model string instead of preserving the Bedrock model.
Escalation targets must be filtered to match the primary model's provider when both are determinable; higher rungs with different providers should be dropped rather than crossed.
